category.title: Category (mode=search)

condition.description: Restrict results to one exact product-condition facet. Most regular stock has no condition facet, so combine with care.
condition.title: Condition (mode=search)

discountedOnly.description: Only emit products with a genuine discount: a source discount percentage, or a list price genuinely above the current price.
discountedOnly.title: Discounted only

facetFilters.description: Optional server-side attribute filters as `field:value` pairs. Supported fields: acoustic_guitar_body_style, amplifier_application, amplifier_type, body_material, brand, case_included_type, category_hierarchy, coating, cymbal_pads, cymbal_size, d_reed_strength, drum_head_material, drum_head_size, drum_head_type, drum_pad_material, drum_set_type, drum_shell_finish_type, drum_shell_material, effects_type, electric_guitar_body_style, final_price, fingerboard_material, instrument_type_mouthpiece, multi_effects_effect_types, number_of_channels, number_of_frets, number_of_keys, number_of_microphone_preamplifiers, number_of_pickups, number_of_speakers, orientation, pads_total, pickup_configuration, snare_drum_construction, snare_drum_depth, snare_drum_type, speaker_configuration, speaker_type, top_material. Examples: `number_of_channels:2`, `number_of_microphone_preamplifiers:2`, `number_of_keys:88 Keys`, `pickup_configuration:H-S-S`. Values must match the site's facet values exactly; unknown field names are ignored with a warning.
facetFilters.title: Facet filters (mode=search)

includeRelatedProducts.description: Fetch up to `relatedProductsCount` similar products for each emitted product. This adds one request per product, so it is off by default.
includeRelatedProducts.title: Include related products

includeReviews.description: Fetch public PowerReviews rating/review data for each emitted product. This adds one request per product and is off by default. Products without reviews omit the review fields.
includeReviews.title: Include ratings and reviews

itemClass.description: Restrict results to one exact item class reported by the source (used for open-box, restock and clearance inventory).
itemClass.title: Item class (mode=search)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted products. The source returns at most 100 products per page and serves at most 100 pages per query, so 10,000 is the practical ceiling per filter combination.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Only include products priced at or below this amount. Applied by the source as `filter.final_price.high`.
maxPrice.title: Max price (USD)

minPrice.description: Only include products priced at or above this amount. Applied by the source as `filter.final_price.low`.
minPrice.title: Min price (USD)

mode.description: What to fetch: a keyword/category search, or exact lookups by SKU or full product URL.
enumTitles: Look up exact products by SKU or product URL
mode.title: Mode

newArrivalsOnly.description: Only emit products flagged as new arrivals.
newArrivalsOnly.title: New arrivals only

onSaleOnly.description: Only emit products flagged as on sale.
onSaleOnly.title: On sale only

priceDropOnly.description: Only emit products flagged with a recent price drop. This is a separate source flag from `onSaleOnly`.
priceDropOnly.title: Price drops only

promotionsOnly.description: Only emit products flagged as eligible for a merchandising promotion.
promotionsOnly.title: Promotions only

relatedProductsCount.description: How many similar products to request for each emitted product (1-10). Only used when `includeRelatedProducts` is true.
relatedProductsCount.title: Related products per product

reviewCount.description: How many individual reviews to include when `includeReviews` is true (1-25). The total rating count is always reported separately.
reviewCount.title: Reviews per product

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword search (mode=search). Leave empty to browse the whole catalog or a selected category. The search reads every catalog-visible product, including uncategorized ones.
searchQuery.title: Search query

skus.description: Exact Sam Ash SKUs or full samash.com product URLs. Examples: `GES35500N`, `https://www.samash.com/gibson-es-335-50s-semi-hollow-electric-guitar-natural-ges35500n`. Duplicates are removed.
skus.title: SKUs or product URLs (mode=bySkus)
